name: realanalystjobs
description: Live analyst jobs and AI and machine learning jobs from employers' own careers pages, checked daily.

interface.longDescription:
RealAnalystJobs is a job search plugin for analysts and AI and machine learning people. It finds open data, business, BI, product and financial analyst jobs, and in a separate list AI and ML jobs (machine learning, AI and LLM engineers, AI research and applied scientists, MLOps, AI product managers), checked every day against employers' own careers pages, so job seekers and career switchers see real, current openings.

Ask things like "data analyst jobs in Bangalore for freshers", "AI engineer jobs in San Francisco", "is Wise hiring analysts?" or "which skills do analyst jobs in the UK ask for?". RealAnalystJobs answers from its live board: real roles with the company, title, location, the date each was first seen and the salary when the employer posts one. Each role links to its page on realanalystjobs.com.

Six read-only tools:
- Search live analyst jobs, or AI and ML jobs, by title or skill, AI role family, city or country, remote, seniority and recency.
- Check one company's open roles: analyst count, titles, locations, skills and newest roles, with its AI and ML roles reported separately.
- Job-market stats for analysts or for AI and ML roles: live role counts, most-asked skills, top cities and companies, the remote share and seniority mix, for the whole board or one place. For AI roles it also lists the employers with US roles that have an H-1B record.
- Check a company's H-1B record: USCIS approvals by fiscal year, beside its live analyst and AI roles and what each posting says about sponsorship. The record is employer-wide history, not a promise for one role.
- Remote analyst roles for a country: based there, naming a region that includes it, or worldwide, with a separate count of roles that state no country.
- Match a resume to live analyst roles: the best fits with a fit estimate and its parts. The resume is used only for that answer and is not stored.

Coverage: analyst roles in India, the UK and Europe, the US, the Gulf and remote, and AI and ML roles as a separate list. Counts are the live rows on the board on the date shown, not the whole job market. No account or sign-in needed; the app cannot change anything.
defaultPrompt: Use RealAnalystJobs to find data analyst jobs in Bangalore posted this week.
Use RealAnalystJobs to find AI engineer jobs in San Francisco.

positive.description: Search live analyst roles by place and recency
positive.prompt: Find data analyst jobs in Bangalore posted this week.
positive.expected_behavior: States how many live roles match on RealAnalystJobs with the date, then lists up to 10 of the newest Bengaluru roles with company, title, location, posted date and a realanalystjobs.com/job link for each.
Gives Wise's live analyst role count with the date, its role titles, locations and most-asked skills, its newest roles with links, and a link to the Wise company page on realanalystjobs.com.

positive.description: Summarise the analyst job market for a country
positive.prompt: What skills do analyst jobs in the UK ask for most?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the live UK role and company counts with the date, the most-asked skills with percentages (for example SQL, Python, Excel), the cities most named in listings and the remote share. It gives no salary average.

positive.description: Check a company's H-1B record beside its live roles
positive.expected_behavior: Shows USCIS H-1B approvals for Snowflake by fiscal year with the data date, says this is employer-wide history and not a promise for any one role, and lists Snowflake's live analyst roles with what each posting says about sponsorship.

positive.description: Find remote analyst roles open from a country
positive.prompt: Remote analyst jobs I can take from Nigeria.
positive.expected_behavior: Groups remote analyst roles by what each listing says: based in Nigeria, naming a region that includes Nigeria, or worldwide, each with a link, plus separate counts of remote roles that state no country and roles tied to other countries.

positive.description: Search AI and ML roles by place
positive.prompt: Find AI engineer jobs in San Francisco.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_analyst_jobs with vertical ai (or ai_family ai_engineer) and location San Francisco. States how many live AI and ML roles match with the date, then lists up to 10 of the newest with company, title, location, first-seen date, any posted salary and a realanalystjobs.com/job link for each. No apply links.

positive.description: Employers hiring an AI family that have an H-1B record
positive.prompt: Which companies hire machine learning engineers with an H-1B record?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyst_market_stats with ai_family ml_engineer and location US. Lists employers with live US machine learning engineer roles and their USCIS H-1B approvals, says the record is employer-wide history across all occupations and not a promise for any role, and that an employer missing from the data is not a non-sponsor. No salary average.

positive.description: Count AI jobs in a country
positive.prompt: How many AI jobs are open in the US?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyst_market_stats with vertical ai and location US. Gives the live AI and ML role and company counts with the date, the role families, top cities and companies, and the count by the employer's own posting date beside the first-seen count. It does not add analyst roles to the AI count and gives no salary average.

negative.description: Applying on the user's behalf is not supported
negative.prompt: Apply to this data analyst job for me.

negative.description: Roles outside analyst, data and AI work are out of scope
negative.prompt: Find me nurse jobs in Texas.

negative.description: The plugin is read-only and cannot post or edit listings
negative.prompt: Post a job listing for my company on RealAnalystJobs.

review.commerce_description: RealAnalystJobs does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Results link to role pages on realanalystjobs.com.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.0: AI and machine learning roles. search_analyst_jobs and analyst_market_stats gain two optional inputs, vertical (analyst or ai) and ai_family, to search and count the separate AI and ML list; company_analyst_hiring and h1b_sponsor_check report a company's AI and ML roles in a separate ai section; AI stats list employers with US roles and an H-1B record. Also since the last review: match_resume_to_jobs (a resume scored against live analyst roles, not stored), the offset input for paging search results, and first-seen date wording. Every change is read-only and backward compatible.
